flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4317/fixtures/shop/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
Using only the keyboard, search for headphones and add Field Headphones to the cart.
Confirm Cart (1).
